Yes, a read-only user can create API credentials. They must be either Owner or Admin roles to access the API credentials page and create new ones. However, they cannot create reports, modify settings, invite users, or access the application token page. Instead, they will receive a 403 status code if they try to do any of these actions. To create an API credential, sign in as Owner or Admin, then open Settings > API credentials, create a new key, and copy it. Once created, the read-only user can use the copied secret to generate a new API key. This API key allows them to authenticate themselves on the API credentials page and begin creating reports, managing users, and modifying settings.
